title: 第15章 光与影第16章 考核消息
slug: 从一证永证开始成神第432章
content_zh:
;;
今日叶霄回武馆，除了燃料不足外，还有另一层原因。
他不能消失太久。
他这条命刚从泥里抬起一点，任何“突然改变行踪”的痕迹，都会引来多看一眼。哪怕只是无心的一眼，他也不愿意。
雾里，练功场的青石透着寒。
叶霄站在最角落，摆开定岳桩。
脚分开半尺，膝微屈，胯收，脊背一线拔直……动作不乱，甚至十分精准。
可下一息，他的呼吸就乱了一拍。
定岳桩要沉，更要松、匀、长。
这几日北炉把他掏得太狠，不只赤血桩撑不久，现在连定岳桩也开始发虚。
他只能用更硬的办法去压：脚心踩死，腰腹绷紧，肩背也跟着锁住。
这种硬撑的姿势，又被缓慢纠正。
每一次细小的偏差，都被无形的力推回正位：脚趾扣回、膝线归中、胯骨收拢、脊柱拉直。
于是外人看到的是……
桩架很正，却有一丝压不住的抖；重心很沉，却沉得发硬；气息想拉长，却一截一截断开。
几名外门学员远远扫来一眼，先是一怔，随即笑出了声：
“诶，那不是哑巷来的那个？”
“架子摆得还行，劲全是死的。定岳桩最忌死扛，他这叫把自己站废。”
“哈哈，还以为他多厉害，原来就会摆架势。”
他们越说越顺，嘲笑碎石般砸过来。

叶霄眼皮都没抬。
他只在心里把问题拆得更细：姿势能摆正，气却走不匀；重心能沉下去，人却松不开。
再找不到足够的燃料，别说定岳桩，崩岳拳也会跟着练不动。
薛婵的声音在雾里落下：
“安静。”
她看了叶霄一眼，没有夸，也没有讥，只淡淡道：
“桩架对了。”
“但你在用硬劲站定岳。”
“回去把呼吸放慢，别急着沉，先把‘匀’练出来。”
下一瞬，练功场的注意力却被硬生生拉走。
把众人注意力拽走的，是一阵脚步声。
脚步沉稳、干净，像刀刃落在青石上……不响，却让人心里一紧。
雾被脚步切开，一个少年从内门方向走来。
眉眼端正得近乎刻板，目光落在人身上，像在衡量一件器物，清澈，却没有温度。
content_en:
;;
Today, Ye Xiao returned to the martial arts gym for another reason besides lack of fuel.
He couldn't disappear for long.
His life has just been lifted out of the mud, and any trace of a "sudden change of whereabouts" will attract a second look. Even if it's just an innocent glance, he doesn't want it.
In the fog, the bluestone of the training ground was cold.
Ye Xiao stood in the far corner and set out the Dingyue pile.
The feet are half a foot apart, the knees are slightly bent, the hips are retracted, and the back is straight...the movements are not chaotic, even very precise.
But in the next breath, his breathing became chaotic.
Dingyue piles must be heavy, loose, even, and long.
Beiluo had beaten him too hard in the past few days. Not only did the red blood pile last long, but now even the Dingyue pile began to weaken.
He could only use a harder method to press: crushing the soles of his feet, tightening his waist and abdomen, and locking his shoulders and back.
This rigid posture was slowly corrected.
Every small deviation is pushed back to the correct position by invisible force: the toes are buckled, the knee line is centered, the hips are drawn in, and the spine is straightened.
So what outsiders see is...
The pile frame is very upright, but there is a slight tremor that cannot be suppressed; the center of gravity is heavy, but it is so heavy that it is hard; the breath wants to be lengthened, but it is broken off one by one.
Several outer sect students glanced at it from a distance, were startled at first, and then laughed out loud:
"Hey, isn't that the one from Mute Alley?"
"The airs are OK, but the strength is dead. The most important thing to avoid is carrying the Dingyue Zhuang to death. This means that he will lose his standing."
"Haha, I thought he was so powerful, but he actually knows how to put on a show."
The more they talked, the smoother they became, and they threw them at me like rubble.
Ye Xiao didn't even raise his eyelids.
He just broke down the problem into more details in his mind: his posture could be straightened, but his energy was uneven; his center of gravity could sink, but he couldn't let go.
If you can't find enough fuel, let alone Ding Yue Zhuang, Beng Yue Quan will also be unable to follow suit.
Xue Chan's voice fell in the fog:
"Quiet."
She glanced at Ye Xiao, neither praising nor ridiculing, she just said lightly:
"The stakes are set correctly."
"But you are using your strength to stand firm."
"Go back and slow down your breathing. Don't rush to sink. Practice the 'evenness' first."
The next moment, the attention of the training ground was abruptly pulled away.
What drew everyone's attention away was the sound of footsteps.
The steps were steady and clean, like a knife blade falling on bluestone... There was no sound, but it made people feel nervous.
The fog was cut open by footsteps, and a young man came from the direction of the inner door.
His eyebrows were straight and almost rigid, his gaze fell on the person, as if he were measuring an object, clear but without warmth.
